page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3g.13xlarge is a local SSD storage-oriented virtual instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. Running on the x86_64 architecture, it is driven by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The configuration allocates 52 dedicated vCPUs derived from 26 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU incorporates 35 MB of L3 cache alongside support for AVX-512, VNNI, and AES instructions. Memory capacity stands at 192.0 GB, providing an allocation of 3.69 GB per vCPU. Hardware accelerators are absent, with a GPU count of zero.

Integrated directly into the instance is 2879 GB of local SSD storage, paired with a 16 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. Benchmark evaluations place single-threaded CPU throughput in the lower quartile, as seen in a single-core stress-ng score of 1314.39 and a single-threaded gzip compression rate of 22.67 GB/sec. In contrast, multi-threaded execution operates consistently within the middle tier, yielding a multi-core Geekbench score of 11816.0, a PassMark CPU score of 37822.26, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression speeds of 193.67 GB/sec. Uncached large-block memory read bandwidth measures 107.27 GB/sec, while write bandwidth reaches 47.98 GB/sec.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.i3g.13xlarge lies in its modest single-core throughput versus its substantial parallel capacity and storage density. The direct integration of 2879 GB local SSD storage yields high I/O density without relying on separate network-attached disks, enhancing qualitative cost efficiency for read- and write-intensive services. With Redis SET performance reaching 40.63 million operations per second and static web serving throughput hitting 27.4 GB/sec, the instance is well matched for relational databases, NoSQL distributed data nodes, in-memory caching tiers, and multi-threaded backend batch processing.
